description: RW-040 combined acceptance cases. A case runs only when every requirement is supplied; otherwise the guest reports it as blocked together with the stages that prepared its fixtures. 'integrator-probe' is the integrator's exact combined read probe (bins/executor/tests/combined_read_probe.rs, binary and source hash); 'integrator-worker' is the later bounded, killable combined worker. Modes: 'root' is unrestricted guest root; 'confined' is the reproduced, unchanged storage-reader confinement.
